text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The final leg of the Classic Triple Crown 
route! The one who claimed the glorious 
chrysanthemum crown is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega! It's Admire Vega!! A 
tremendous roar erupts for her fierce, 
unstoppable run!
(WAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (...This is nowhere near enough.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(This isn't enough. It won't make up for 
it. Not compared to the sin I've 
committed!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
......It is still far, far from enough to 
offer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san...

Returning to my room, I ponder over our 
target race.

Admire Vega's demeanor— ultimately 
remained unchanged even after winning the 
Kikuka Sho.

"...Just like before, she looked deeply 
troubled by something."

"Considering her goal of 'continuing to 
dedicate supreme glory to her late 
sister,' the next target in her sights 
should perhaps be the year-end 'Arima 
Kinen'—"

Or perhaps I thought it would be the 
Spring Senior Triple Crown route, and had 
been making preparations for that.

“And she should take a somewhat longer 
rest. ...So that she may 'continue to 
fulfill' her purpose.”

Let's set our next target for early next 
summer after a brief break: the Takarazuka 
Kinen. I began preparations so I could 
discuss it with her.

—The night following that fateful Kikuka 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(I have to push myself. I have to whittle 
myself down. More, more, right to the very 
limit...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Until I've... completely exhausted 
myself...!)
Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Good evening. Where are you off to? 
Curfew is almost up, you know."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's night training. I've submitted the 
application.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Training... is it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
By the way, have you told your Trainer 
about that?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...You haven't... have you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san. ...Please, don't push yourself 
too hard.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday was the actual race, you know. 
You really should rest your body a bit 
more...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Does it really matter?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It has nothing to do with you, does it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I-It does matter! What are you talking 
about...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whether in the Satsuki Sho, the Japan 
Derby, or the Kikuka Sho! No, even before 
all of that, haven't we been running 
together as classmates and rivals?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"We've run together, competed together... 
We're comrades, aren't we?!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't push yourself to the point 
of getting hurt! Please take better care 
of yourself too!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Please stop.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Please, I'm begging you... Go back to the 
dorm and rest for today...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll rest, get better, train hard, and 
then...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Let us compete together again—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Stop it!!

The sound of swatting away the 
outstretched hand leaves a dry echo in the 
dark night.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Stop it. Enough already.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Don't come any closer to me...!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...You're dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
So don't come, don't get any closer. Don't 
shine your light on me any more than this.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Because if I don't, I won't be able to see 
it anymore. ...I won't be able to talk 
with her anymore.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If you are not in the dark of night, the 
starlight cannot reach you. I must be in a 
dark, dark place.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's why. ...—Please, I'm begging you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Do not violate me with your light.

In the profoundly deep, pitch-black 
darkness that threatened to swallow 
everything whole—

The documents prepared for the Takarazuka 
Kinen basked faintly in the starlight.
